<TITLE>EX-10.3</TITLE>
</HEAD>
 <BODY BGCOLOR="WHITE" STYLE="line-height:Normal">

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><B>Exhibit 10.3 </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>Vylor Inc. </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>Change in
Control and Executive Severance Plan </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>ARTICLE I </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>PURPOSE </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This Change in
Control and Executive Severance Plan has been established by the Company on October&nbsp;1, 2026 (the &#8220;<B>Effective Date</B>&#8221;) to provide certain employees of the Company with the opportunity to receive certain severance protections. The
Plan, as set forth herein, is primarily intended to help retain qualified employees, maintain a stable work environment and provide economic security to eligible employees in the event of certain qualifying terminations of employment. Capitalized
terms used but not otherwise defined herein have the meanings set forth in Article II. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Plan is not intended to be included in the
definitions of &#8220;employee pension benefit plan&#8221; or &#8220;pension plan&#8221; set forth under Section&nbsp;3(2) of ERISA. The Plan is intended to meet the descriptive requirements of a plan constituting a &#8220;severance pay plan&#8221;
within the meaning of regulations published by the Secretary of Labor at Title 29, Code of Federal Regulations, <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Section&nbsp;2510.3-2(b).</FONT> Notwithstanding the foregoing, if and to the extent that the Plan is
deemed to be an &#8220;employee pension benefit plan&#8221; or &#8220;pension plan&#8221; as set forth under Section&nbsp;3(2) of ERISA, then the Plan is intended, for all purposes under ERISA, to constitute a plan that is unfunded and maintained by
the Company primarily for the purposes of providing deferred compensation for a select group of management or highly compensated employees. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>ARTICLE II </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>DEFINITIONS
</B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Accrued Compensation</B>&#8221; means in respect of any Participant: (i)&nbsp;Base Salary accrued by the Participant
through, but not paid to the Participant as of, the Qualifying Termination Date, (ii)&nbsp;any cash incentive bonus earned by the Participant in respect of the most recent completed fiscal year preceding the Qualifying Termination but not paid to
the Participant as of the Qualifying Termination Date and (iii)&nbsp;any vested employee benefits to which the Participant is entitled as of the Qualifying Termination Date under any employee benefit plan of the Company. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Administrator</B>&#8221; means the Compensation Committee or its delegate. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Affiliate</B>&#8221; means any entity that, directly or through one or more intermediaries, is controlled by Vylor. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Award</B>&#8221; has the meaning set forth in the Omnibus Incentive Plan. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Base Salary</B>&#8221; means the Participant&#8217;s annual base salary as in effect immediately prior to the Qualifying Termination
Date or, if higher, as in effect immediately prior to the occurrence of an event or circumstance constituting Good Reason. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Beneficial Owner</B>&#8221; (or any variant thereof) has the meaning defined in Rule <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">13d-3</FONT>
under the Exchange Act. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Benefit Continuation</B>&#8221; has the meaning set forth in Section&nbsp;3.02(d). </P>
</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Benefit Continuation Coverage</B>&#8221; means: </P>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="5%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="6%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(i)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">in the case of the CEO, three (3)&nbsp;years if a Qualifying Termination occurs during the Covered Period and
two (2)&nbsp;years if a Qualifying Termination occurs outside of the Covered Period, </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD WIDTH="5%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="6%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(ii)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">in the case of a Tier 2 Participant, two (2)&nbsp;years if a Qualifying Termination occurs during the Covered
Period and one and one half (1<SUP STYLE="vertical-align:top">1</SUP>&#8260;<SUB STYLE="vertical-align:bottom">2</SUB>)&nbsp;years if a Qualifying Termination occurs outside of the Covered Period, </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="5%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="6%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(iii)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">in the case of a Tier 3 Participant, one and one half (1<SUP STYLE="vertical-align:top">1</SUP>&#8260;<SUB
STYLE="vertical-align:bottom">2</SUB>)&nbsp;years if a Qualifying Termination occurs during the Covered Period and one (1)&nbsp;year if a Qualifying Termination occurs outside of the Covered Period, </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="5%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="6%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(iv)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">in the case of a Tier 4 Participant, (A)&nbsp;one (1) year if a Qualifying Termination occurs during the
Covered Period and (B)&nbsp;one (1) month for every two (2)&nbsp;completed years of service (with a minimum of six (6)&nbsp;months and a maximum of twelve (12)&nbsp;months) if a Qualifying Termination occurs outside of the Covered Period and
</P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="5%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="6%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(v)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">in the case of a Tier 5 Participant, one (1)&nbsp;month for every two (2)&nbsp;completed years of service (with
a minimum of six (6)&nbsp;months and a maximum of twelve (12)&nbsp;months). </P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Benefit Continuation
Period</B>&#8221; means the period commencing on the Qualifying Termination Date and ending upon the earlier to occur of (i)&nbsp;completion of the number of years under the applicable Benefit Continuation Coverage and (ii)&nbsp;the date on which
the Participant becomes eligible to receive coverage on substantially similar terms from another employer or, in the case of Outplacement Services, the date on which the Participant accepts an offer of full-time employment from a subsequent
employer. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Board</B>&#8221; means the Board of Directors of Vylor. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Cause</B>&#8221; has the meaning set forth in the Omnibus Incentive Plan (determined without regard to the provisions of any
&#8216;Award Agreement&#8217; within the meaning of the Omnibus Incentive Plan). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>CEO</B>&#8221; means the Chief Executive
Officer of Vylor from time to time. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Change in Control</B>&#8221; means the first occurrence of an event set forth in any one of
the following paragraphs following the Effective Date: </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(i) any Person is or becomes the Beneficial Owner, directly or
indirectly, of securities of Vylor (not including in the securities Beneficially Owned by such Person which were acquired directly from Vylor or any Affiliate thereof) representing more than thirty percent (30%) of the combined voting power of
Vylor&#8217;s then outstanding securities, excluding any Person who becomes such a Beneficial Owner in connection with a transaction described in clause (A)&nbsp;of paragraph (iii)&nbsp;below; or </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(ii) the date on which individuals who constitute the Board as of the Effective Date and any new director (other than a
director whose initial assumption of office is in connection with an actual or threatened election contest, including, but not limited to, a consent solicitation, relating to the election of directors of Vylor) whose appointment or election by the
Board or nomination for election by Vylor&#8217;s stockholders was approved or recommended by a vote of at least <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">two-thirds</FONT> (2/3) of the directors then still in office who either were directors on the
Effective Date or whose appointment, election or nomination for election was previously so approved or recommended cease for any reason to constitute a majority of the number of directors serving on the Board; or </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">2 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(iii) there is consummated a merger or consolidation of Vylor or any direct
or indirect Subsidiary (as defined in the Omnibus Incentive Plan) with any other corporation or other entity, other than (A)&nbsp;a merger or consolidation (I)&nbsp;which results in the voting securities of Vylor outstanding immediately prior to
such merger or consolidation continuing to represent (either by remaining outstanding or by being converted into voting securities of the surviving entity or any parent thereof), in combination with the ownership of any trustee or other fiduciary
holding securities under an employee benefit plan of Vylor or any Subsidiary, more than fifty percent (50%) of the combined voting power of the securities of Vylor or such surviving entity or any parent thereof outstanding immediately after such
merger or consolidation and (II)&nbsp;following which the individuals who comprise the Board immediately prior thereto constitute at least a majority of the board of directors of Vylor the entity surviving such merger or consolidation or, if Vylor
or the entity surviving such merger or consolidation is then a Subsidiary, the ultimate parent thereof, or (B)&nbsp;a merger or consolidation effected to implement a recapitalization of Vylor (or similar transaction) in which no Person is or becomes
the Beneficial Owner, directly or indirectly, of securities of Vylor (not including in the securities Beneficially Owned by such Person any securities acquired directly from Vylor or its Affiliates) representing more than fifty percent (50%) of the
combined voting power of Vylor&#8217;s then outstanding securities; or </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:4%; text-indent:13%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(iv) the stockholders of Vylor approve a plan of
complete liquidation or dissolution of Vylor or there is consummated an agreement for the sale or disposition by Vylor of all or substantially all of Vylor&#8217;s assets, other than (A)&nbsp;a sale or disposition by Vylor of all or substantially
all of Vylor&#8217;s assets to an entity, more than fifty percent (50%) of the combined voting power of the voting securities of which are owned by stockholders of Vylor following the completion of such transaction in substantially the same
proportions as their ownership of Vylor immediately prior to such sale or (B)&nbsp;a sale or disposition of all or substantially all of Coretva&#8217;s assets immediately following which the individuals who comprise the Board immediately prior
thereto constitute at least a majority of the board of directors of the entity to which such assets are sold or disposed or, if such entity is a subsidiary, the ultimate parent thereof. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Notwithstanding the foregoing, (i)&nbsp;a Change in Control shall not be deemed to have occurred by virtue of the consummation of any
transaction or series of integrated transactions immediately following which the holders of Common Stock immediately prior to such transaction or series of transactions continue to have substantially the same proportionate ownership in an entity
which owns all or substantially all of the assets of Vylor immediately following such transaction or series of transactions and (ii)&nbsp;to the extent required to avoid accelerated taxation and/or tax penalties under Section&nbsp;409A of the Code,
a Change in Control shall be deemed to have occurred under the Plan with respect to any payment or benefit that constitutes deferred compensation under Section&nbsp;409A of the Code only if a change in the ownership or effective control of Vylor or
a change in ownership of a substantial portion of the assets of Vylor shall also be deemed to have occurred under Section&nbsp;409A of the Code. For purposes of this definition of Change in Control, the term &#8220;Person&#8221; shall not include
(w)&nbsp;Vylor or any Subsidiary thereof, (x)&nbsp;a trustee or other fiduciary holding securities under an employee benefit plan of Vylor or any Subsidiary thereof, (y)&nbsp;an underwriter temporarily holding securities pursuant to an offering of
such securities, or (z)&nbsp;a corporation owned, directly or indirectly, by the stockholders of Vylor in substantially the same proportions as their ownership of shares of Vylor. </P>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">3 </P>

</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Code</B>&#8221; means the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended. Any reference
to a section of the Code shall be deemed to include a reference to any regulations promulgated thereunder. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Company</B>&#8221;
means Vylor and, except as the context otherwise requires, its Affiliates and wholly-owned subsidiaries and any successor by merger, acquisition, consolidation or otherwise. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Compensation Committee</B>&#8221; means the People and Compensation Committee of the Board. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Covered Period</B>&#8221; means the period of time beginning on the first occurrence of a Change in Control and lasting through the <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">two-year</FONT> anniversary of the occurrence of the Change in Control. &#8220;<B>Vylor</B>&#8221; means Vylor Inc., a Delaware corporation. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Effective Date</B>&#8221; has the meaning set forth in Article I. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>ERISA</B>&#8221; means the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974, as amended. Any reference to a section of ERISA shall be
deemed to include a reference to any regulations promulgated thereunder. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Exchange Act</B>&#8221; means the Securities Exchange
Act of 1934, as amended from time to time. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Excise Tax</B>&#8221; means any excise tax imposed on the Participant under
Section&nbsp;4999 of the Code. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Good Reason</B>&#8221; has the meaning set forth in the Omnibus Incentive Plan (determined
without regard to the provisions of any &#8216;Award Agreement&#8217; within the meaning of the Omnibus Incentive Plan). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Omnibus Incentive Plan</B>&#8221; means the Vylor Inc. 2026 Omnibus Incentive Plan, as may be amended from time to time. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Participant</B>&#8221; means each of the CEO, Tier 2 Participants, Tier 3 Participants, Tier 4 Participants and Tier 5 Participants.
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Person</B>&#8221; shall have the meaning given in Section&nbsp;3(a)(9) of the Exchange Act, as modified and used in Sections
13(d) and 14(d) thereof. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Plan</B>&#8221; means this Vylor Inc. Change in Control and Executive Severance Plan, as may be
amended from time to time. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Qualifying Termination</B>&#8221; means the termination of a Participant&#8217;s employment either
by the Participant for Good Reason (in the case of Tier 3 Participants, Tier 4 Participants and Tier 5 Participants, during the Covered Period only) or by the Company without Cause. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Qualifying Termination Date</B>&#8221; means the date on which a Participant incurs a Qualifying Termination. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Restricted Period</B>&#8221; means the one (1)&nbsp;year period following a Qualifying Termination. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;<B>Severance Multiple</B>&#8221; means: </P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(i)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">in the case of the CEO, three (3)&nbsp;in respect of a Qualifying Termination during the Covered Period and two
(2)&nbsp;in respect of a Qualifying Termination outside the Covered Period, </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">4 </P>

</DIV></Center>
